'''Solida Hesk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] businesswoman who worked for the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
In [[3638 BBY]], she and the mining corporation were aiding the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] to study [[Isotope-5]] and sell out the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. She was hosting a summit to three [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Clan lord]]s - [[Prodoranya]], [[Manju (Hutt)|Manju]], and [[Khobisho]] - at her resort estate on one of [[Makeb]]'s mesas. However, an Imperial strike team gained access to the estate and the Hesk corporation's records. The team were able to determine that a large stockpile of isotope-5 was being held in a vault designated "[[Stronghold One]]," initially designed for the planetary treasury. Solida encountered the Imperial strike team and was executed.
